checks: Boss waits as a dormant, untargetable signal until the player is near.
Dormant boss hides the wire limbs and is a 7.2m signal.
All three lamps are dark while dormant.
Awakening reveals all four wire limbs and makes the boss targetable.
Lamps flicker while the boss awakens.
Awake boss stands 12.0m tall.
Lamps cycle red, green, yellow, red... (Green Yellow Red Green Yellow Red Green Yellow Red Green Yellow).
Lamp changes stay under one second apart (longest 0.90s).
Boss can start the red field pattern.
The signal holds red while the field charges.
The field draws 3 safe circles of radius 3.2.
Every safe circle lies inside the arena.
A safe circle starts within 7.5m of the player (nearest edge -1.3m).
An exposed floor position exists outside every circle.
The signal turns green at the judgement.
Circle edge is judged by the feet at the exact radius.
Standing outside the circles costs 28 health (72 left).
Second field pattern starts.
Standing inside a safe circle takes no damage.
Boss can start the car throw.
The signal shows yellow while the car is wound up.
A car projectile exists after the release.
The car stays alive long enough to travel (665 frames).
The car moves along one straight heading (max deviation 0.000m).
The car drops onto the floor line (9.2m down to 2.3m, resting 2.3m).
A car on the locked line hits for 26 (74 left, hits 1, player (0.00, 0.01, -12.00), dashing False).
Second car throw starts.
Stepping off the locked line avoids the car.
A car that misses is removed at the arena wall.
Third car throw starts.
Sedan, taxi and van all appeared in three throws (mask 7).
Below half health the boss enters its second phase.
Second-phase field starts.
Second phase uses fewer, smaller safe circles (2 x 2.72m).
Defeat stops the field and darkens the lamps.
Defeat removes flying cars.
